items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: You know that’s the one Ray Charles played on “What’d I Say” that just blew everybody’s mind.

ctx.x: There’s the Wurlitzer piano shows up in a number of your videos. Did they have Wurlitzer piano over there?

Yeah. Yeah. They had everything. And the Wurlitzer was before the Fender Rhodes. It was the first electric keyboard. You know that’s the one Ray Charles played on “What’d I Say” that just blew everybody’s mind.
